title: H439 — Agentic RAG architecture for PEAD NLP signal generation
rationale: arXiv:2604.04264 'Decoding market's pulse: Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation for financial document analysis' (2026). 3-agent pipeline: (1) Retriever agent identifies relevant passages from SEC filings, (2) Analyst agent synthesizes sentiment and earnings quality signals, (3) Trader agent converts to entry/exit recommendations. Paper reports outperformance of GPT-4o single-agent baseline on earnings reaction prediction. Directly compatible with H274 (multi-agent PEAD debate) and H163/H174 production pipeline (FinBERT single-model). The agentic RAG approach could improve WR above 81.8% by using more context per filing and structured reasoning across agents. Estimated cost: ~$0.15/event with gpt-4o-mini at scale.
content: Design stub: 3-agent pipeline using OpenAI API. Agent 1 (Retriever): pulls relevant paragraphs from EDGAR 8-K text by section (Item 2.02 + surrounding context). Agent 2 (Analyst): scores sentiment, earnings quality, surprise magnitude. Agent 3 (Trader): generates +1/0/-1 signal with confidence. Backtest: apply to H174 OOS events (n=22, WR=81.8%) and compare. Gate: WR > 81.8% AND n >= 15 events. Requires $OPENAI_API_KEY (already in env).
notes: Medium risk — new script only; does not touch existing PEAD production pipeline until confirmed

design.universe: H174 OOS earnings events (n=22) + new 2026 events
agents: Retriever: extract 3-5 key paragraphs from 8-K using semantic search
Analyst: structured scoring (sentiment 1-5, EPS beat/miss confidence, revenue quality)
design.implementation_path: run_h439.py → H174 event list → OpenAI API → signal DataFrame → eval vs H174 WR
